title: Accidental Snapshot Shot List Lab
model_settings: Gemini mode picker selected 3.1 Pro - Advanced math and code; thinking level menu visible as Standard; composer model button showed Pro before both prompts.

source_inspiration.notes: PromptHero Top prompts page showed a highly engaged theme around deliberately mediocre or sloppy iPhone flash selfies, with visible counts 158 and 10008 near one card. Treated only as demand for believable casual-photo planning; no third-party prompt text was copied.

pathforge_fit_adaptation: Adapted the image-generation prompt demand into a deterministic offline browser lab for planning casual reference-shot cards: angle, lighting flaw, composition flaw, wardrobe/prop continuity, realism flags, and copyable shot brief. It is a self-contained artifact under public/artifacts with no AI call, CDN, remote font, or external dependency.
final_artifact_clue: Open the lab, edit the four shot cards, toggle a realism flag, and press Copy Shot Brief to generate a concise casual-shot plan.
verification_notes: v1 saved as real artifact but rejected as final because static scan found inline onclick and alert() modal fallback.
Repair prompt sent in same Gemini session naming inline onclick and alert() defects.

Final/default artifact static scan clean for inline handlers, innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/document.write, alert/confirm/prompt modal APIs, remote http(s), @import, Google Fonts, CDN strings.
Served final artifact locally at http://127.0.0.1:8765/public/artifacts/accidental-snapshot-shot-list-lab-gemini.html for Chrome verification.

Chrome verification: page rendered with title/h1 Casual Reference Shot Lab, four textareas, three checkboxes, and Copy Shot Brief button; desktop scrollWidth 1420 at innerWidth 1420 initially, then workflow state scrollWidth 1405 at innerWidth 1420.

Workflow verification: filled all four cards, checked Too Vague, warning became visible, Copy Shot Brief produced toast-success and clipboard included the filled angle plus REALISM STATUS: FLAGGED: Too Vague.

Playwright package was not installed for a separate headless narrow-viewport run; layout uses responsive auto-fit minmax(300px, 1fr), body max-width 800px, box-sizing on textareas, flex-wrap checkbox group, and full-width copy button, so tablet/desktop intended viewport is covered and narrow accidental overflow risk is limited.

steps.prompt_exact: Make me a small offline browser shot-list lab for planning deliberately casual reference photos: I want editable cards for angle, bad lighting, composition flaw, wardrobe/prop continuity, a realism checklist that flags too-polished, too-vague, or production-ready, and a button to copy or export a concise shot brief as a single self-contained HTML file I can save and open.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a self-contained HTML casual reference shot lab with four editable cards, realism flags, warning box, and copyable brief.
